parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Filters periodic streak created after this datetime in ISO

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Filters periodic streak created until this datetime in ISO

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Attributes should be in format of key:value

action_threshold.description: Number of times a progress_action_key should be performed to increase streak length by 1 in a period

started_at.description: ISO Datetime when the streak will start, if null then streak is started from the day of creation

stopped_at.description: ISO Datetime when the streak will stop being active, if null then streak will never end, unless its archived.

freeze_start.description: ISO Datetime for starting the freeze period for everyone, so that any action performed by user will not result in streak length or any miss will not reset their streak

freeze_until.description: ISO Datetime for ending the freeze period for everyone, so that any action performed by user will not result in streak length or any miss will not reset their streak

freeze_reason.description: Optional reason for freezing the streak, only valid if one of freeze_start or freeze_until is provided

profile_group_ids.description: List of Livelike profile group ids to which this streak will be applicable, if not provided, streak will be available for all.
